{{Top|leg}}
A '''species''' native to [[Gargon Two]] had a primitive warrior society at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Species/Legends|species]] had been trained by the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] long before that, leading to rumors that the long-dead Taung were alive on Gargon Two.
